notes.title: NightCry Physical Goods Backers - Update your Addresses!
notes.notes:
Hi all

For those of you who backed NightCry’s Kickstarter and are expecting Physical goods, please check our latest Kickstarter update.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/playism/project-scissors-nightcry/posts/1804035

We need everyone to update their addresses so that we can get all your items to you safely. 

We only have until February 14th 12pm Japan Time to finish updating all the addresses. So we are going to need all your cooperation on this. If you have moved, please make sure your survey addresses are up to date!

notes.title: 6/29 Update
notes.notes:
After receiving a large number of opinions and feedback from everyone, we have made the following updates. 

Some small modifications to the subtitles and some minor bug fixes. 

We look forward to hear more of your feedback and bug reports. 

We hope you keep enjoying NightCry.

notes.title: NightCry release date announced!
notes.notes:
Exciting news for you all. The release day for NightCry has been decided. 

This [b]March 29th, 2016[/b], you can expect to see NightCry out on Steam and PLAYISM.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iEMsbp7oeDA

As the days pass, the anticipation is building. Very soon, the Scissorwalker will be creeping up on you.
